name: Jackson Furniture / Catnapper
old_description: Our TN plants will resume business operations at 9AM Wed the 17th
about:
Jackson Furniture Industries, operating under the Catnapper brand, is headquartered in Cleveland, Tennessee. The company was founded in the United States and remains focused on domestic manufacturing, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a privately held enterprise with no stated veteran, woman, or family ownership designation.

The company produces residential furniture including reclining sofas, sectionals, and seating sets across 10 factories. Its manufacturing processes feature computer-cut wood parts reinforced with extra glue and stapling, steel springs made from 12-gauge heat-tempered steel in the back and 8-gauge steel in the seat, an exclusive Steel Tech framing system with steel rails and stretchers, Comfort Gel layers for cooler seating and reduced motion transfer, and comfort coil seat cushions backed by a five-year warranty. The operation employs over 1,500 dedicated employees and vendors.

Jackson Furniture serves the residential furniture market primarily through a network of retail partners. Its products are sold to consumers via brick-and-mortar retailers, with the company providing a "Find A Retailer" tool on its website. No specific commercial or institutional customers are named.

The company emphasizes its American-made heritage and community investment. Over the past five years, it has contributed more than $1.5 million to organizations including Habitat for Humanity, the American Heart Association, the Anti-Defamation League, the United Way, and the Boy Scouts of America. This philanthropic focus, combined with a domestic production footprint, is presented as a core differentiator.
